text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Narita 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you really need to pray to God at 
this point?

I'm worried about Narita Brian, who hasn't 
been herself lately. So, I told her that I 
wanted to say a prayer for her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen, managing my physical condition 
is my own responsibility. It has nothing 
to do with God or Buddha."
choice_data_list: I want to do everything I can.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Fine, if you insist that much, 
I'll tag along.

I prayed to the gods for Narita Brian's 
swift and full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, time to go.
choice_data_list: What did you pray for, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not praying for anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I only went along with it because I 
thought it would satisfy you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. Just a difference in habits, I 
suppose. However, allow me to say this 
much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Your body is your own responsibility to 
manage. And victory is something you seize 
for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The one who will grant your wish isn't God 
or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —It's me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, if you get it, then let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, a nice breeze blows through 
here, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not feeling bad at all. ...Maybe I'll 
go for a quick run before heading back.

Perhaps thanks to the nice change of pace, 
Narita Brian's steps were light and brisk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...What's this? The scent of the wind is 
getting damp..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about this...
(Rumble rumble rumble... whoosh...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So cold...!? Rain... really...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, let's head back already!

Could it be that I've incurred the wrath 
of the gods...?

Drenched by the rain, Narita Brian headed 
back in complete silence...
